$comment: Generated by `cargo run -p xtask -- schema-check --write` from the halyard-core plan types. Do not edit by hand; an ADR is required for format changes.

Bump.description: Bump level, totally ordered `None < Patch < Minor < Major` (§5.5).

PlanChangelog.description: Changelog entry preview for a release (§9.4).

file.description: Repo-relative path of the changelog file that will be edited.

patches.description:
Non-overlapping byte patches, applied right-to-left; byte offsets are
over the file as it exists at [`Plan::head`].

enabled.description: Whether publishing is enabled for this package in this plan.

PlanReason.description: One entry of a reason chain (§5.6), internally tagged by `type`.

oneOf.description: A parsed conventional commit contributed to the bump.

breaking.description: Whether the commit was breaking (`!` or `BREAKING CHANGE` footer).

kind.description: Commit type as parsed (`feat`, `fix`, …); open set.

oneOf.description:
A `Release-As: <version>` footer forced this version (honoured only
from commits on the protected base branch, invariant I7).

oid.description: Hex SHA of the commit carrying the footer.

oneOf.description: A change file (`.halyard/changes/*.md`) contributed the bump (§9.4).

file.description: Repo-relative path of the change file.

oneOf.description: The bump cascaded from a dependency (§10.4).

edge.description:
Dependency edge kind that connects the packages (`normal`,
`build`, `dev`, `peer`, `optional`).

via.description: Name of the upstream package that was bumped.

oneOf.description: The package has no release base yet; this is its initial release.

changelog.description:
Changelog update rendered for this release, when the package has a
changelog file.

from.description:
Current version in the manifest, or `"0.0.0"` when the package has no
version yet (unpublishable, initial state).

package.description: Package name as discovered (crate name or npm package name).

publish.description: Registry publishing decision for this release (§13).

reasons.description:
Why the bump happened; the reason chain that powers `halyard explain`
(§5.6).

tag.description:
Tag that will be created for this release (rendered tag template,
appendix A.3).

to.description: Next version after applying the bump.

PlanSkip.description: A package considered but not released (§5.8 `skipped`).

description:
A complete, serializable release plan (§5.8).

The plan is hashable (blake3 over its canonical JSON) and embedded in the
Release PR body so later runs can verify it and `release`/`publish` can
trust it (invariant I8). Producing the hash is [`crate::canonical::plan_hash`]'s
job; these types carry it as [`Plan::plan_hash`].

base_branch.description: Branch the plan was computed against (e.g. `main`).

edits.description: Byte patches to apply so the working tree reflects the plan.

head.description: Hex commit SHA the plan was computed from.

order.description: Topological publish order: package names, dependencies first.

plan_hash.description: `blake3:<hex>` over the canonical JSON of the plan without this field.

releases.description:
Packages to release, in discovery order (see [`Plan::order`] for the
publish order).

schema.description: Always [`PLAN_SCHEMA_V1`] for documents handled by this code line.

skipped.description: Packages considered but not released, with the reason.

title: Plan
